CS3400.name: Data Structures and Algorithms

CS3520.description: Computer abstractions, RISC-V instruction sets, processor design and performance analysis.

CS3541.description: Network fundamentals, Cisco IOS, switching, routing and Packet Tracer laboratories.

EE3400.name: Electronic Measurements and Instrumentation
EE3400.description: Sensors, strain gauges, instrumentation amplifiers, active filters and measurement reports.

EE3404.name: Electric Circuit Theory
EE3404.description: Circuit elements, nodal and mesh analysis, transients and RLC circuits.

EE3408.name: Analogue Communications
EE3408.description: Analogue modulation, analogue-to-digital conversion, ACM laboratories and reports.

M3503.name: Engineering Mathematics III
M3503.description: Differential equations, higher engineering mathematics, tutorials and the M3503 mini project.
